question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Valid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Logical**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Valid **refers to something that is legally or logically acceptable. (वैध)

 
 
• **Example**: *The passport is still valid for another six months, allowing him to travel without any issues.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Logical **means in accordance with the principles of reasoning or sound judgment; reasonable and sensible. (तार्किक)
 
 
• **Example**: *His argument was logical, presenting facts and evidence to support his case.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Illicit: **Forbidden by law, rules, or custom; illegal. (अवैध)
 
• **Evil: **Morally wrong, wicked, or morally reprehensible. (बुराई)
 
• **Fake: **Not genuine, counterfeit, or not real. (नकली)
